subject: Sequenced acceptance sprint: MAP-driven legal & procurement dependencies for HelixCare pilot

Subject: Pilot procurement: MAP to align MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the demo last week — HelixCare is excited about the pilot. Before we lock dates with our stakeholders, procurement and legal asked that we put a short mutual action plan (MAP) together so the MSA/DPA/order form sequencing is clear.

High level asks from procurement:
- Confirmation of SOC2 + data residency (we need to capture evidence)
- Order form draft for pricing and payment terms
- Target signature window (req: mid-December)

Proposed evaluation window: Nov 23 -> Dec 7. Target signature: week of Dec 14.

Can you send a MAP skeleton with clear checkpoints and who owns each deliverable? Procurement (cc'd) also needs a candidate timeline for internal approvals.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, HelixCare

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement: MAP to align MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Marta — great to hear and thanks for the clear ask.

I've attached a MAP skeleton (pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps evaluation, security evidence, MSA redline, DPA review, and order form signature into a compact sprint. Key sequencing notes:

1) Evaluation access (tech/POC) — immediate: Redwood provides environment + 2 engineers for onboarding (Nov 23 start).
2) Security evidence (SOC2, DPA checklist) — Grace to provide evidence pack; initial DPA requirements attached.
3) Order form draft (pricing + SOW) — sales to push draft to procurement for parallel review.
4) MSA redline — legal review window 3-5 business days after receipt of redline.
5) Signature target — attempt to keep Order Form signature in parallel with MSA/DPA finalization to hit Dec 14.

Proposed quick call to align owners: Thu Nov 12, 11am ET. If that works for procurement (Marta/Jordan) we'll lock the calendar and walk through the MAP.

Attachments: pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (attachment)

Next steps for me: populate owners and a date fence for each checkpoint and share a final MAP on Monday.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@helixcare.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement: MAP to align MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Vanessa / Marta — looping in legal with a few sequencing constraints from our side.

Summary of legal asks and timeline expectations:
- We need the customer's DPA questionnaire returned with point-by-point responses. I've attached our DPA requirements (redwood_dpa_requirements.pdf) so procurement can see what we require.
- SOC2 Type II: acceptable; if HelixCare requires more granular evidence we can provide the report under NDA.
- Data residency: we support US-based regions; please confirm the required region (us-east-1 / us-west-2).
- Legal review cadence: once we receive a redlined MSA, internal review typically takes 3-5 business days for standard edits; complex redlines may add time.

Sequencing recommendation: allow procurement to review Order Form terms in parallel with legal reviewing MSA/DPA. However, we can't sign until DPA controls are agreed unless procurement accepts condition-of-signature (limited).

I'll draft a short 'legal gating checklist' that can be attached to the MAP for transparency. Happy to join the Nov 12 call.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Lead Counsel | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference.com
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@helixcare.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot procurement: MAP to align MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Thanks Karthik — helpful. A few clarifications from procurement:
- SOC2: we have an existing SOC2 for HelixCare; we'll accept Redwood's SOC2 under NDA.
- Data residency: our legal prefers all PHI-adjacent data remain in us-east-1; procurement flags this as mandatory.
- Procurement windows: final signoff for pilots must occur by Dec 16 to meet finance close; earlier is ideal.

I've attached our procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.xlsx) and our RFI response doc; will share the RFI formally after your call.

We can make Thu Nov 12, 11am ET — Jordan and I will be on the call.

Best,
Marta
